scope: Restore the Publish 14.1 active species innates and their authored species, HAM, duration, reuse, targeting, and state-effect authority; reject and scrub the ten retained NGE species-ability commands and buffs for players without removing their compatibility data from later content; and preserve the Novice Scout harvesting boundary.

findings: Two independent preserved PRE-CU skill tables agree that Trandoshans receive Regeneration, Wookiees receive Wookiee Roar, and Zabraks receive Vitalize plus Equilibrium.
Regeneration grants 175 Constitution for 300 seconds and has a 3600-second reuse; Vitalize grants 50 Health, Action, and Mind for 600 seconds and has a 3600-second reuse.
Equilibrium averages current Health, Action, and Mind and moves all three pools to that average; its 3600-second reuse is independent of Vitalize.
Wookiee Roar is an enemy-targeted 15-meter, 90-degree cone that applies a 60-second Intimidate state and has a 300-second reuse.

The retained NGE command and combat tables still contain one *_ability_1 action for each of the ten playable species. PRE-CU species rows grant none of them, but stale command grants and direct attempts could still enter all ten live handlers.

Three retained NGE handlers derived Ithorian block, Trandoshan healing, or Zabrak healing directly from combat level, while the authenticated PRE-CU species innates use species ownership, private innate modifiers, current HAM, and fixed authored values instead.

Player command admission now fails closed over the exact ten-name NGE family before any combat action executes, and login or attempted use revokes stale commands, removes persisted species-ability buffs, and invalidates the NGE Trandoshan heal-over-time state. NPC and content compatibility rows remain retained.
